growth.tokenBasisTip: Tokens are fresh input plus output. Prompt-cache reads and writes are listed separately and not counted, so repeated context is not counted again.
growth.stalePossible: Data may be out of date
growth.quotaErrNotSignedIn: Not signed in to {provider}. Sign in to that CLI in a terminal first; Agent Pets never asks for your credentials.
growth.quotaErrExpired: The {provider} sign-in has expired. Sign in again in that CLI, then retry.
growth.quotaErrTimeout: The request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
growth.quotaErrRateLimited: The quota service is rate limiting requests. Wait a minute and try again.
growth.quotaErrUnavailable: Could not load the {provider} quota right now. Try again later.
growth.quotaKeptLast: Could not refresh. Showing the last successful reading.
growth.autoRefreshNote: Auto-refresh every 2 minutes while the panel is open
growth.quotaEmptyBody: Sign in to the Codex or Claude Code CLI and your subscription quota will appear here.
growth.xpSourceActive: Every 30 minutes of focus   +{xp} (up to +{max} per session)
growth.xpSourceStreak: Each consecutive day from day two   +{xp}
growth.recentEmpty: Once you finish a session, each XP gain and its source will show up here.
growth.nextEvolution: Next title: Lv {level} · {stage} ({levels} levels to go)
growth.firstPending: Finish a task to claim the daily bonus +{xp}
growth.streakRisk: No task finished today yet; complete one to keep your {days}-day streak
growth.etaDays: About {days} days away at your 7-day pace
growth.firstRunCta: Finish your first task to earn +{xp} XP (daily bonus included)
growth.achievementStreak3Help: Use the app 3 days in a row.
growth.achievementStreak30Help: Use the app 30 days in a row.
growth.achievementHiddenHelp: A hidden achievement. Keep exploring to find it.
growth.storageUnavailableBody: Local storage may still be starting, or reading failed. Retry, and restart Agent Pets if it keeps happening.
growth.historyEmptyBody: After your first finished task in Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode, work time, completions and tokens appear here.
growth.historyEmptyHint: Not seeing events yet? Check in Settings that the hooks are installed.
growth.historyIntroBody: Numbers come from local session logs and hook events, are never uploaded, and contain no prompt content. Tokens are fresh input plus output; cache is listed separately.
growth.exportExplain: Tokens are fresh input plus output with cache listed separately; days are local calendar dates in your time zone.
growth.exportWriteFailed: Could not write the file. Check disk space and folder permissions.
growth.exportUnavailable: History is unavailable right now, so it cannot be exported.
growth.clearDetail:
Clears: work history, daily stats, token stats and quota snapshots.
Keeps: pet XP, level, streak and achievements.
growth.resetMoodConfirm: Reset mood to its baseline? This does not affect XP, level or achievements.
